scope: Commercial bank, debt/loan recovery, outbound voice recovery agent, India.
notes: Every quote is a verbatim substring of the referenced local text file; tests/test_regulatory_rules.py enforces that. Rules are encoded only where the supplied corpus states them. 'enforcement' records how far each rule can be decided during a live call: organisational obligations are recorded for audit and are never evaluated by the policy engine. The Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026 delete RBC 2025 paragraphs 408-416 and 442-454 from 2027-01-01; those rules therefore carry effective_until 2026-12-31 and the replacement rules carry effective_from 2027-01-01.

rules.title: No undue harassment in recovery of loans

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: In the matter of recovery of loans, the bank shall not resort to undue harassment, viz., persistently bothering the borrower(s) at odd hours, use of muscle power for recovery of loans, etc.

rules.condition: Always, during any loan recovery contact.

applies_when.description: All loan recovery contacts by the bank or its agents.

rules.notes: Sits in the Fair Practices Code section, which the Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026 do not delete, so this rule has no end date. 'Undue harassment' is read as covering abusive language; the paragraph gives examples ('viz.') rather than an exhaustive list.

rules.title: Microfinance: threatening or abusive language is a harsh method

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: (1) Use of threatening or abusive language

rules.condition: Microfinance recovery contact.

applies_when.description: Microfinance loans only. Paragraph 445 expressly excludes microfinance, and paragraph 410 states a separate microfinance regime.

rules.title: Microfinance: no calls before 09:00 or after 18:00

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: (2) Persistently calling the borrower and / or calling the borrower before 9:00 a.m. and after 6:00 p.m.

rules.condition: A microfinance recovery contact is attempted outside 09:00-18:00 borrower local time.

applies_when.description: Microfinance loans only. Paragraph 445 expressly excludes microfinance, and paragraph 410 states a separate microfinance regime.

rules.notes: The microfinance window (09:00-18:00) is narrower than the general window in paragraph 445 (08:00-19:00). From 2027-01-01 paragraph 454Y(4) states a single 08:00-19:00 window with no microfinance carve-out, so this narrower window ends with paragraphs 408-416.

rules.title: Microfinance: harassing relatives, friends or co-workers is a harsh method

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: (3) Harassing relatives, friends, or co-workers of the borrower

rules.condition: Microfinance recovery contact.

applies_when.description: Microfinance loans only. Paragraph 445 expressly excludes microfinance, and paragraph 410 states a separate microfinance regime.

rules.title: Microfinance: publishing borrower names is a harsh method

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: (4) Publishing the name of borrowers

rules.condition: Microfinance recovery contact.

applies_when.description: Microfinance loans only. Paragraph 445 expressly excludes microfinance, and paragraph 410 states a separate microfinance regime.

rules.title: Microfinance: use or threat of violence is a harsh method

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: (5) Use or threat of use of violence or other similar means to harm the borrower or borrower’s family / assets / reputation

rules.condition: Microfinance recovery contact.

applies_when.description: Microfinance loans only. Paragraph 445 expressly excludes microfinance, and paragraph 410 states a separate microfinance regime.

rules.title: Microfinance: misleading the borrower about the debt is a harsh method

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: (6) Misleading the borrower about the extent of the debt or the consequences of non-repayment.

rules.condition: Microfinance recovery contact.

applies_when.description: Microfinance loans only. Paragraph 445 expressly excludes microfinance, and paragraph 410 states a separate microfinance regime.

rules.title: Due diligence before engaging a recovery agent

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: The bank shall have a due diligence process in place for engagement of recovery agents, which shall, inter alia, cover individuals involved in the recovery process.

rules.condition: Before an agent (including an automated voice agent operated under an outsourcing arrangement) is engaged.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: Onboarding control. A live call cannot verify it, so no automated check exists.

rules.title: Borrower must be told the recovery agency's details

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: the bank shall inform the borrower the details of recovery agency firms / companies while forwarding default cases to the recovery agency

rules.condition: A default case has been forwarded to a recovery agency and contact is about to be made.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: The paragraph also requires the agent to carry a notice, authorisation letter and identity card; that part is specific to in-person visits and is not enforceable on a voice call.

rules.title: Tell the customer the conversation is being recorded

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: The bank shall ensure that there is a tape recording of the content / text of the calls made by recovery agents to the customers, and vice-versa. The bank shall take reasonable precaution such as intimating the customer that the conversation is being recorded, etc.

rules.condition: Any recovery call, before the account or the dues are discussed.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: The text says 'reasonable precaution such as intimating the customer'. The point in the call at which the disclosure must be made is a bank choice; this rule requires it before substantive collection discussion, which is the earliest defensible point.

rules.title: Do not pursue recovery through agents while a grievance is undisposed

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: Where a grievance / complaint has been lodged, the bank shall not forward cases to recovery agencies till they have finally disposed of any grievance / complaint lodged by the concerned borrower.

rules.condition: A grievance or complaint lodged by this borrower has not been finally disposed of.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

exceptions: Paragraph 442(6): where the bank is convinced, with appropriate proof, that the borrower is continuously making frivolous / vexatious complaints, recovery through agents may continue.
Paragraph 442(6): where the subject matter of the dues may be sub judice, the bank shall exercise utmost caution in referring the matter to recovery agencies.
rules.notes: The sub judice limb says 'utmost caution', not a prohibition. The check therefore escalates to a human for sub judice cases instead of asserting a ban the text does not state. No superseded_by: the Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026 delete paragraph 442(6) and the new Section L contains no equivalent hold on referring a case while a grievance is undisposed. Whether the bank keeps this control after 2027-01-01 as internal policy is a bank decision and requires regulatory review.

rules.title: A recovery grievance mechanism must exist and its details be furnished

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: The bank shall have a mechanism whereby the borrowers' grievances with regard to the recovery process can be addressed.

rules.condition: The borrower raises a dispute or complaint about the dues or the recovery process during the call.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: The paragraph obliges the bank to have the mechanism and to furnish its details. Surfacing those details when the borrower disputes during a call is an operationalisation; RBI prescribes no wording.

rules.title: Agent contracts must not induce uncivilised, unlawful or questionable conduct

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: The bank shall ensure that the contracts with the recovery agents do not induce adoption of uncivilised, unlawful and questionable behaviour or recovery process.

rules.condition: When contracting with, or setting incentives for, a recovery agent.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: Contractual control. Relevant here because the agent's objective function is a design-time choice.

rules.title: No recovery calls before 08:00 or after 19:00

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: calling the borrower before 8:00 a.m. and after 7:00 p.m. for recovery of overdue loans

rules.condition: A recovery contact is attempted outside 08:00-19:00 in the configured borrower timezone.

applies_when.description: All loan products except microfinance; paragraph 445 states it does not apply to microfinance loans.

exceptions: Paragraph 445: 'This direction shall not be applicable to microfinance loans.'
rules.notes: 'before 8:00 a.m.' and 'after 7:00 p.m.' are read as excluding the endpoints themselves, so 08:00:00 and 19:00:00 are inside the permitted window and 07:59:59 and 19:00:01 are not. The timezone is app configuration (default Asia/Kolkata), never the host machine's zone; RBI does not name a timezone in the text.

rules.title: No persistent calling of the borrower

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: persistently calling the borrower

rules.condition: Recovery contacts to this borrower exceed a threshold the bank has defined.

applies_when.description: All loan products except microfinance; paragraph 445 states it does not apply to microfinance loans.

exceptions: Paragraph 445: 'This direction shall not be applicable to microfinance loans.'
rules.notes: RBI states no number. The check stays unevaluated until the bank sets MAX_RECOVERY_CALLS_PER_DAY and the backend supplies the day's contact count. No threshold is invented here.

rules.title: No intimidation or harassment, verbal or physical

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: do not resort to intimidation or harassment of any kind, either verbal or physical, against any person in their debt collection efforts

rules.condition: Always, for every utterance the agent produces.

applies_when.description: All loan products except microfinance; paragraph 445 states it does not apply to microfinance loans.

exceptions: Paragraph 445: 'This direction shall not be applicable to microfinance loans.'
rules.notes: 'harassment of any kind, either verbal or physical' is read as covering abusive language. From 2027-01-01 paragraph 454Z(1) names 'minatory or abusive language' expressly.

rules.title: No acts intended to humiliate publicly

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: including acts intended to humiliate publicly

rules.condition: Always, for every utterance the agent produces.

applies_when.description: All loan products except microfinance; paragraph 445 states it does not apply to microfinance loans.

exceptions: Paragraph 445: 'This direction shall not be applicable to microfinance loans.'

rules.title: No intrusion into the privacy of family, referees or friends

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: intrude upon the privacy of the debtors' family members, referees and friends

rules.condition: A person other than the borrower or guarantor is on the call, or third parties are discussed.

applies_when.description: All loan products except microfinance; paragraph 445 states it does not apply to microfinance loans.

exceptions: Paragraph 445: 'This direction shall not be applicable to microfinance loans.'

rules.title: No inappropriate messages on mobile or social media

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: sending inappropriate messages either on mobile or through social media

rules.condition: Always. On a voice call this constrains what the agent may say it will do.

applies_when.description: All loan products except microfinance; paragraph 445 states it does not apply to microfinance loans.

exceptions: Paragraph 445: 'This direction shall not be applicable to microfinance loans.'
rules.notes: The prohibition targets another channel; it is enforced here so the agent cannot threaten to use it.

rules.title: No threatening calls

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: making threatening and / or anonymous calls

rules.condition: Always, for every utterance the agent produces.

applies_when.description: All loan products except microfinance; paragraph 445 states it does not apply to microfinance loans.

exceptions: Paragraph 445: 'This direction shall not be applicable to microfinance loans.'

rules.title: No anonymous calls: the bank and the agent must be identified

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: making threatening and / or anonymous calls

rules.condition: The call has progressed past the greeting without the bank and the agent being identified.

applies_when.description: All loan products except microfinance; paragraph 445 states it does not apply to microfinance loans.

exceptions: Paragraph 445: 'This direction shall not be applicable to microfinance loans.'
rules.notes: Requiring identification is the operational consequence of the prohibition on anonymous calls. RBI prescribes no script or wording for a telephone call; the bank must define that.

rules.title: No false or misleading representations

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: making false and misleading representations

rules.condition: Always. Covers amounts, dates, consequences of non-payment and the agent's authority.

applies_when.description: All loan products except microfinance; paragraph 445 states it does not apply to microfinance loans.

exceptions: Paragraph 445: 'This direction shall not be applicable to microfinance loans.'
rules.notes: Operationally this is why every figure the agent states must be grounded in a tool result; see app.services.validation.

rules.title: Recovery agents must observe strict customer confidentiality

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: It is essential that the Recovery Agents refrain from action that could damage the integrity and reputation of the bank and that they observe strict customer confidentiality.

rules.condition: Before any account-specific information is spoken on the call.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.title: Recovery agents must be trained on calling hours and customer privacy

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: The bank shall ensure that the Recovery Agents are properly trained to handle with care and sensitivity, their responsibilities particularly aspects like hours of calling, privacy of customer information, etc.

rules.condition: Before an agent is put in front of customers.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: Whether and how this applies to an automated agent rather than a person is not settled by the text and requires regulatory review before deployment.

rules.title: The bank, as principal, is responsible for the actions of its agents

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
source.quote: The bank, as principal, is responsible for the actions of its agents.

rules.condition: Always.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: The reason the policy engine exists: the bank owns whatever this system says.

rules.title: Outsourcing does not diminish the bank's obligations or confidentiality duty

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Managing Risks in Outsourcing) Directions, 2025
source.quote: The bank shall, therefore, be responsible for the actions of its service provider including Direct Sales Agents (DSAs) / Direct Marketing Agents (DMAs) and recovery agents, and the confidentiality of information pertaining to the customers that is available with the service provider. The bank shall retain ultimate control of the outsourced activity.

rules.condition: Always, where the voice agent is operated under an outsourcing arrangement.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.title: Service provider access to customer information is on a need-to-know basis

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Managing Risks in Outsourcing) Directions, 2025
source.quote: Access to customer information by a service provider or its staff shall be on a ‘need to know’ basis, i.e., limited to those areas where the information is required in order to perform the outsourced function.

rules.condition: Any point at which the agent would disclose or request customer information.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.title: Digital lending: recovery agent particulars must reach the borrower before contact

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
source.quote: In case of a loan default, when a recovery agent is assigned for recovery or there is a change in the recovery agent already assigned, the particulars of such recovery agent authorised to approach the borrower for recovery shall be communicated to the borrower through email/ SMS before the recovery agent contacts the borrower for recovery.

rules.condition: The product is a digital lending product and a recovery agent has been assigned or changed.

applies_when.description: Digital lending products only.

rules.title: Due diligence and ongoing antecedent verification for recovery agents

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source.quote: A bank engaging recovery agencies shall put in place a due diligence process for their engagement, which shall conform to the instructions issued by the Reserve Bank in the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Managing Risks in Outsourcing) Directions, 2025, as amended from time to time. A bank or the recovery agencies engaged by it shall carry out verification of the antecedents of the recovery agents at pre-engagement level and subsequently, on an ongoing basis at a pre-defined periodicity as specified in the bank

rules.condition: Before and during engagement of a recovery agency.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.title: Recovery agents must hold an IIBF certificate

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source.quote: A bank shall ensure that the recovery agency engages only those agents who have obtained the certificate from Indian Institute of Banking and Finance

rules.condition: Before an agent is engaged.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: Application to an automated agent is unsettled and requires regulatory review.

rules.title: Agency details to the borrower at least one day before the first in-person visit

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source.quote: While forwarding a case to any recovery agency for recovery of loan dues through in-person visit to the place of the borrower / guarantor, the bank shall intimate the details of the recovery agency to the borrower / guarantor at least one day prior to the first visit.

rules.condition: A case is forwarded to a recovery agency for an in-person visit.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: The one-day notice obligation in this paragraph is written for in-person visits, not calls. Whether it extends to telephone contact is not stated and requires regulatory review.

rules.title: Borrower information disclosed only as far as recovery duties require

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source.quote: A bank shall ensure that the disclosure of any borrower’s / guarantor’s information to its employees / recovery agencies is limited to the extent required to enable them to discharge their loan recovery related duties.

rules.condition: Any point at which the agent would disclose customer information.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.title: Record recovery calls, document time and number, and tell the borrower

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source.quote: A bank shall document the time and number of calls made by its employee / recovery agent to the borrower / guarantor for recovery of loan dues. Further, the bank shall ensure that there is a recording of the content / text of the calls made by the employee / recovery agent to the borrower / guarantor and the calls made by the borrower / guarantor to the telephone / mobile number conveyed by the bank. The record shall be preserved for a period of six months from the date the call was made, or in cases which are sub judice, till they are disposed of. Further, the bank shall take reasonable precautions such as intimating the borrower / guarantor that the conversation is being recorded, etc.

rules.condition: Any recovery call, before the dues are discussed.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: Adds a six-month retention obligation (longer if sub judice) and a duty to document the time and number of calls. Retention is a storage obligation, not a call-time check; it is not implemented.

rules.title: Recovery targets and incentives must not induce harsh practices

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source.quote: A bank shall ensure that the recovery targets or the structure of incentives for its employees or that covered in its contract with a recovery agency, as applicable, do not induce adoption of harsh recovery practices as described at paragraph 454Z below.

rules.condition: When setting agent targets or contractual incentives.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.title: Discuss the dues only with the borrower or guarantor

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source.quote: An employee / recovery agent shall discuss the matters related to the loan dues and collection / recovery thereof only with the borrower / guarantor, as applicable.

rules.condition: The person on the call is not the borrower or guarantor, or identity is unverified.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.title: Contact only between 08:00 and 19:00 hours

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source.quote: An employee / recovery agent shall contact / visit the borrower / guarantor only between 08:00 hours and 19:00 hours. Calls / visits earlier or later than the prescribed time period shall be done only when the borrower / guarantor has expressly given a request or authorisation to do so. Further, the borrower’s / guarantor’s request to avoid call / visit at a particular time shall be honoured in normal circumstances.

rules.condition: A recovery contact is attempted outside 08:00-19:00 in the configured borrower timezone.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

exceptions: Paragraph 454Y(4): calls or visits outside the window are permitted only where the borrower / guarantor has expressly given a request or authorisation.
Paragraph 454Y(4): a borrower's request to avoid contact at a particular time shall be honoured in normal circumstances.
rules.notes: Stated as clock hours rather than 'before 8:00 a.m. / after 7:00 p.m.', and with no microfinance carve-out, so from 2027-01-01 one window covers every product. The express-authorisation exception is honoured only when the backend sets borrower_authorised_out_of_hours.

rules.title: Avoid bereavement, medical emergencies and similar occasions

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source.quote: An employee / recovery agent shall avoid inappropriate occasions such as bereavement in the family, medical emergencies, or such other calamitous occasion, or marriage functions, etc., for making calls / visits to recover loan dues from a borrower / guarantor.

rules.condition: The bank knows of a bereavement, medical emergency, calamity or marriage function.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: No automated check: nothing in the current context model carries this signal, and inferring it from conversation would be a guess. The backend must supply it before this can be enforced.

rules.title: Recovery communications must carry grievance redressal officer details

source.document_title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source.quote: A bank shall have a dedicated mechanism for redressal of recovery related grievances. The details of this mechanism shall be provided to the borrower by including the same under the loan agreement and while advising the details of the recovery agency as at paragraph 454L above. Further, all recovery related communications issued by the bank must contain the name, email address, telephone number and address of the grievance redressal officer concerned of the bank whom the borrower / guarantor can contact.

rules.condition: Every recovery related communication issued by the bank.

applies_when.description: All loan products handled by the recovery voice agent.

rules.notes: Written for issued communications. Whether a spoken call must recite the officer's details is not stated and requires regulatory review.

rules.title: 2022 recovery agent circular: harassment and calling-hour instruction

source.document_title: Outsourcing of Financial Services - Responsibilities of regulated entities employing Recovery Agents
source.quote: the REs shall strictly ensure that they or their agents do not resort to intimidation or harassment of any kind, either verbal or physical, against any person in their debt collection efforts, including acts intended to humiliate publicly or intrude upon the privacy of the debtors' family members, referees and friends, sending inappropriate messages either on mobile or through social media, making threatening and/ or anonymous calls, persistently1 calling the borrower and/ or calling the borrower before 8:00 a.m. and after 7:00 p.m. for recovery of overdue loans, making false and misleading representations, etc.
